context_requirements: Expression of thyroid peroxidase (TPO) or a functional thyroid hormone synthesis pathway
Thyroid follicular cell lineage with TSH/cAMP-responsive thyroglobulin (TG) transcription
Presence of the target enzyme TPO; none of the nine tested lines are thyroid-derived
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Induction of a thyroid-specific transcriptional program (e.g., TG, TSHR, PAX8, NKX2-1) in any line
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls and not explained by vehicle or general toxicity

evidence.supports: Antithyroid agent sulfadimethoxine alters gene expression in a rat thyroid carcinogenesis model, but the observed changes are in thyroid follicular lesions, not in non-thyroid cell lines.
Methimazole transcriptionally increases thyroglobulin mRNA in FRTL-5 rat thyroid cells, a thyroid-specific effect requiring thyroid lineage context and taking hours to appear.
